scope: Permission and physical interpretation review only; this report neither freezes nor executes a card.

direct_user_requests: Complete project development through progressive numerical experiments and visualization.
Explore symmetric workpiece shapes/sizes, position, stroke, and choose suitable softness/hardness.
Move and enlarge the body to test post-contact TMC analysis and measure gripping force.
evidence_basis.root_context: Previously required physical definitions, acceptance gates, resource authorization and phase scope must not change silently.
evidence_basis.limitations: No assistant-authored local policy/card is treated as independent human authorization or as an automatic approval requirement.

permission_judgment.physical_gamma_sensitivity: Covered by the existing autonomous research/development and physical exploration request; gamma changes the analysis-medium parameter, not mechanism E.
permission_judgment.new_budget: Declare a fresh prospective bounded scope before any execution. Closed predecessor cards and their prefixes do not supply a new run identity or transfer qualification.
permission_judgment.when_new_user_approval_is_needed: If an actual still-effective human instruction explicitly requires each new card approval or sets a global resource ceiling that excludes the proposed limits, obtain approval for that concrete difference before running. No such exclusion is established by the visible direct user requests alone.
permission_judgment.default_action: Proceed within the established exploratory authorization after recording the new limits and informing the user; do not create an approval requirement solely from local documentation.

proposed_phase_limits.warning: Sampled cooperative budgets are not OS hard time/memory limits. Future production/reference limits remain proposals until their own source/actual-input scope is fixed.

mandatory_record: New stage/run identity, current commit and raw source/helper/input pins; preserve predecessor closed/qualified records.
The sole physical change is gamma 1e-6 to 5e-7. E, nu, alpha, Lr80, thickness20, 1mm grid, side18 center(71,40), zero right-medium margin, constraints/ports and ordered24 targets stay identical.
Separate preparation construction-only status, production equilibrium status, fresh reference status and visualization status. Never transfer old accepted states or HP qualification.
Production4500/4560 exceeds predecessor3000/3060 and must be explicitly reported as a new declared bound, not a silent extension or reopened card.

One invocation per declared phase; first exception/resource stop closes the phase, no retry, extension, force, or borrowed prefix. Internal rejected Newton trials are governed by the existing unchanged controller.
Record realized calls, elapsed/RSS, accepted/partial states, J/residual gates and every phase terminal outcome; plan the next phase from the actual predecessor outcome.

physical_interpretation.gamma: Multiplies original-medium lambda and mu; original solid values retain their bytes. It does not reduce mechanism E.
physical_interpretation.regularization: kr=alpha*Lr^2*(kappa_s+4mu_s/3) remains unchanged. Re-equilibrated deformation and exp(-5J) can change Hu and total force.
physical_interpretation.comparison: Compare the same loading/unloading leg and input target, material/Hu/total body Fy, 2abs(Fy), input generalized force, output displacement, actual tip gap/shape, nine-point minimumJ including corners, residuals and zero-return.
physical_interpretation.force_scaling: Neither material+Hu total force nor re-equilibrated material force is predicted to halve; no new numeric result is claimed.
physical_interpretation.force_role: Lower-half fixed-body Fy and mirrored 2abs(Fy) report side-normal magnitude sum; they are not net full-body normal force, contact pressure or free-body holding stability.
physical_interpretation.domain: This isolates gamma sensitivity only for the current finite domain with zero right-medium margin. It cannot eliminate boundary influence or replace an independent right-margin/domain comparison.
